companyName: Texas Wind Portfolio (Stella, Cranell, East Raymond, West Raymond)
rationale: Vela Wind Holdco, LLC is the proved common parent of the 861 MW Texas Coastal Wind Facilities. RWE's audited 2025 statements retain its 25% interest. The original 24% Greencoat ownership is supported by audited and regulatory evidence and no later transfer was identified. The four wind farms remain subordinate assets rather than separate PortCos.
